title: Variables and Expressions
introduction: Variables hold gameplay state, while operators calculate, compare and update their values.
learningOutcomes: Declare, initialise and update typed variables.
Use arithmetic, comparison and logical operators.
Use const for a value that must not change.

activities.question: Complete the operator that adds points to score: score ___ points;
activities.explanation: += adds the right-hand value to the existing left-hand value and stores the result.

activities.question: Which expression is true only when health is positive and the player is alive?
activities.explanation: The && operator requires both the positive-health comparison and isAlive to be true.
